author: Sarah Perez
title: Apple TV adds support for Google Cast even as Netflix ditches the feature | TechCrunch
description: The tech giant's adoption of Google Cast signals its interest in making Apple TV a more competitive streaming service at a time when the market is seeing increased consolidation.
content: Apple is making it easier for Android users to watch Apple TV content on the big screen. The company on Monday said the Apple TV app for Android will now support Google Cast functionality, which lets… [+1265 chars]
